title: Countdown Milestone Reminder Drift
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=countdown:event milestone=*
| stats latest(days_remaining) as days_remaining, count as reminders by milestone
| sort days_remaining
description: Tracks whether milestone reminders are firing at the right points in a countdown.
value: A countdown is more fun and useful when the little markers arrive on time instead of in a blur at the end.
implementation: Send milestone countdown events into `index=personal`; review reminder frequency and current days remaining by milestone.
visualization: Table of milestones with reminders fired and days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It warns whether the little milestones in a countdown are turning up when they should instead of bunching awkwardly at the end.
